dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, you look so serious today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's because Paimon's thinking about serious things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's jealous of people from wealthy and influential families. They have an endless supply of Mora and mountains of delicious food to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't disagree. Those are exactly the things you're fond of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But after getting to know Ayaka better, Paimon realized that a young lady from a noble family can also have her share of hardships.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She needs to shoulder her clan's duties and responsibilities. She works so hard and has very little time for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayaka must be exhausted, she should try to relax a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that's right! Let's invite Ayaka to the next festival!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If she got an invite from us, there's no way she'd refuse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, if Ayaka's around, she can pick up the tab for us...

choices.text: I'd like to go to another festival with her.
